reason: Considered HOLD, with real doubt. The book is down 20.6 percent, concentrated in semiconductors (AVGO, TSM, AMAT, ASML, QCOM, SMH) and carries no stop-losses. Research was thin: searches could not confirm the 11-20 drivers, and the results on the chip selloff were largely stale or undated. Reports that a hotter inflation print, AI debt worries and Chinese memory-architecture news drove chip weakness are unverified and dated. Trimming now would lock in losses of 13 to 41 percent on names whose AI-infrastructure thesis I have not seen broken, and I cannot identify a specific fundamental failure to act on. The cost is that this book keeps its full semiconductor drawdown exposure, which I accept as the known risk of the strategy. I will revisit once the drivers of the chip selloff can be confirmed from dated sources.
